title: Rust: audit hash_32 calls for byte order and identifier width
description:
Per spec 2a.10.7, verify all FNV-1a32 calls use:
- Network byte order (big-endian) for multi-byte inputs
- Full 16-byte DODAG ID where applicable (not truncated to 8 bytes)
Check: lichen-core, lichen-link, lichen-rpl crates
Add test vectors to hash_32.json if missing.
